parameters.query:
SELECT id,
  portal,
  COALESCE(url, '') AS url,
  COALESCE(color, '') AS color
FROM moveadvisor_market_offers
WHERE (COALESCE(color, '') = '')
  AND last_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
  AND (enrich_tried_at IS NULL OR enrich_tried_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days')
  AND COALESCE(url, '') <> ''
ORDER BY enrich_tried_at ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 400
